'''Eeth Koth's lightsaber''' was a lightsaber owned by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

==History==
[[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] built his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] drawing from the design used by his former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Indeed, when [[Kosul Ayada]] became one with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Koth constructed a [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilt]] that resembled the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]]'s own as a way of memorializing his master.<ref name="TPM EVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

By the end of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Koth's lightsaber was carried by fellow [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councilor]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]],<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> for which Windu had exchanged [[Mace Windu's blue-bladed lightsaber|his blue saber]] in the [[Concordance of Fealty]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ceremony demonstrating mutual trust. Koth returned the lightsaber to Windu shortly before the latter embarked on a [[Lannik–Red Iaro peace negotiations|diplomatic mission]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to negotiate peace between the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]] terrorists and the [[R'cardo Sooflie IX|prince]] of the [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik people]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="SW13">[[Star Wars (1998) 13|''Star Wars'' (1998) 13]]</ref>

[[File:Koth_torture.png|left|thumb|Eeth Koth dueling General Grievous]]
Eeth Koth was part of the [[Jedi assault team/Legends|task force]] led by Mace Windu, sent to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to help [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. He wielded his lightsaber during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Koth's]] cruiser was boarded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] he engaged Grievous in a lightsaber duel, which resulted in [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|his capture]], but Koth was skilled enough that he was able to hold Grievous off long enough, even though he had taken a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot to one [[Limb/Legends|arm]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==

Eeth Koth's lightsaber first appears in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], its hilt being briefly glimpsed on Mace Windu's person. This was established by the Concordance of Fealty ritual,<ref name="SW13" /> a retcon created to address the inconsistent appearance between Windu's onscreen saber hilt and his blue-bladed one referenced in later media.<ref>[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref><ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Windu's Episode I action figure features the film's lightsaber with a blue blade,<ref>[[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''Star Wars: The Power of the Force'' (1995)]]</ref> and while Koth's is portrayed as such in flashbacks from  [[Star Wars (1998) 11|issue 11]] of ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'',<ref name="SW11">[[Star Wars (1998) 11|''Star Wars'' (1998) 11]]</ref> all further appearances portrayed it with a green blade.
